chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 42: Li Huowang Meets Abbot Xin Hui at Zhengde Temple
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang reaches Zhengde Temple and confronts Abbot Xin Hui. His report on Danyangzi's "ascension" leads to a shocking verdict: Danyangzi has become a Buddha.
og_title: He Became a Buddha: The Revelation at Zhengde Temple - Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 42
og_description: Abbot Xin Hui delivers a chilling answer to Li Huowang's most pressing question. What did Danyangzi truly become after his death?
twitter_title: The abbot's calm gaze and pink eyes hide a truth darker than any monster. Danyangzi didn't ascend—he became something far worse.
twitter_description: Li Huowang finally finds the temple that hunted Danyangzi. But the abbot's answer changes everything: "He has become a Buddha."
